cases.question: What error resolution applies to error code ERR_AUTH_REVOKED_4039?
cases.referenceAnswer: Error ERR_AUTH_REVOKED_4039 indicates the organization API key expired or was revoked. Re-issue the token in Settings > API Keys.
referenceContexts: Code ERR_AUTH_REVOKED_4039: API token revoked. Resolution: Navigate to Settings > API Keys to generate a replacement token.

cases.question: Can I cancel my insurance?
cases.referenceAnswer: Cancellation requirements depend on your policy type (Auto, Property, or Life). Please provide your policy number or let me connect you with support.
